{{Quote|It's a standard forward base where they re-supply their troops and tend to the wounded. If we can get them here, we might be able to push the Empire back long enough for everyone to make it off of the planet.|A Rebel commando|<ref name="SWG:aRc">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|a Rebel commando|Yavin 4}}</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Fortress''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military base and [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].

==History==
{{Quote|We have little hope of defeating all of the Imperial forces on this Yavin moon, but at the very least we've disrupted their ability to search for others of the Alliance who are stranded here. We intend to hold this base for as long as possible and weaken the Imperial position here as much as possible, but we've already had to defend against a patrol of stormtroopers. Please advise on the availability of reinforcements!|Intercepted Rebel transmission|<ref name="10HSTG" />}}
[[File:Rebel_occupied_Imperial_base.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Stormtroopers and Rebel troops fighting for the control of the base.]]
The Imperial Fortress was built by the Empire after the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Evacuation of Yavin|evacuated]] Yavin 4,<ref name="SWG:IOoY" /> six months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The base was commanded by [[Vraker Orde]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> A [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] was based in this outpost in order to fight renaming Rebel troops hidden in the jungles and to prevent any attempt of the Alliance to reuse Yavin 4 as a base.<ref name="SWG:IOoY" /> Ironically, the Rebels managed to briefly occupy the base shortly after its construction.<ref name="10HSTG" />

Later, members of the [[Black Epsilon]] and [[Storm Squadron/Legends|Storm Squadron]] were stationed at the fortress to receive various space combat missions to fight Rebel presence in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]]. Officers of this two detachments included [[Haymir Rendundi]], [[Field Commander/Legends|Field Commander]] [[Alozen]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Denner]]. [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonel]] [[Barlow]] was also based at the Imperial Fortress.<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> two Imperial technicians, [[Tellulon]] and [[Arlo]], were based at the outpost. The former was in fact a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] who eventually convinced the latter to defect to the Alliance.<ref name="SWG:EDR">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=faction|Rebel|Empire Day Revealed|Tatooine}}</ref> Around the same time, [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] tasked a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operatives to raid the [[Detainment Facility|Imperial Detainment Facility]] in the fortress during the [[Remembrance Day]] festivities. The Rebel agents successfully [[Rescue at Yavin 4|rescued]] six Rebel pilots from the facility.<ref name="SWG:Rt6AP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Rebel|Rescue the sixth Alliance Pilot|Yavin 4}}</ref>
